## Section 4: Covenant Summary and Compliance

### 4.1 Existing Covenants and Compliance (2023 Credit Agreement)

The FY2025 compliance certificate under the existing 2023 credit agreement is dated April 28, 2026 [D1, §7]. Total leverage was 1.90x against a 3.50x maximum [D1, §7]. DSCR was 1.61x against a 1.20x minimum [D1, §7]. The borrower complied with both financial covenants [D1, §7].

The 2023 facility had two financial covenants, each tested quarterly: a maximum total leverage ratio of 3.50x and a minimum DSCR of 1.20x [D3, Part B §4].

The Q4 2024 compliance certificate arrived 18 days late [D5, ¶3]. Credit Administration waived the reporting covenant under waiver W-25-0117 [D5, ¶3]. All later certificates arrived on time [D5, ¶3].

### 4.2 Proposed Financial Covenants (Draft Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, Sept 22, 2026)

**Maximum Total Leverage Ratio.** "The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio, as of the last day of any fiscal quarter, to exceed 3.25 to 1.00; provided that for each fiscal quarter ending on or after December 31, 2027, the maximum shall be 3.00 to 1.00." [D2, §7.1] The ratio is Total Funded Debt on the test date divided by EBITDA for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended [D2, §1.1].

**Minimum Debt Service Coverage Ratio.** "The Borrower shall not permit the Debt Service Coverage Ratio to be less than 1.25 to 1.00 as of the last day of any fiscal quarter." [D2, §7.2] The ratio is (a) EBITDA minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures minus cash taxes paid, divided by (b) scheduled payments of principal and interest on Total Funded Debt, for the four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended [D2, §1.1].

**Capital Expenditures.** "Unfinanced Capital Expenditures shall not exceed $2,500,000 in any fiscal year; provided that capital expenditures for the Expansion Project, not exceeding $6,000,000 in the aggregate, shall be excluded." [D2, §7.3] "Expansion Project" is defined in Schedule 1.1, which is not in the excerpt [D2, §1.1].

**Pro forma figures on the FY2025 basis, as spread.** Pro forma total funded debt is 26,200 [D1, Table 3: Total funded debt, Pro forma]. Pro forma total leverage is 2.52x [D1, Table 3: Total leverage, Pro forma]. Pro forma debt service is 5,600 [D1, Table 3: Debt service, Pro forma]. Pro forma DSCR is 1.38x [D1, Table 3: DSCR, Pro forma]. FY2025 unfunded capex is 1,400 ($ in thousands) [D1, Table 1: Unfunded capex, FY2025].

### 4.3 Reporting Covenants

The Borrower must deliver the following [D2, §7.4]:
- Annual consolidated financial statements, audited by an independent accounting firm acceptable to the Lender, within 120 days after each fiscal year end [D2, §7.4(a)].
- Internally prepared quarterly consolidated financial statements, within 45 days after each fiscal quarter end [D2, §7.4(b)].
- With each quarterly delivery, a Compliance Certificate signed by a financial officer, showing the Total Leverage Ratio under §7.1 and the Debt Service Coverage Ratio under §7.2 for the period then ended [D2, §7.4(c)].

### 4.4 Negative Pledge

The Borrower shall not create, incur or permit to exist any Lien on any of its assets, except Permitted Liens [D2, §7.5(a)]. Permitted Liens are [D2, §7.5(b)]:
- (i) Liens in favor of the Lender.
- (ii) Liens securing the Equipment Notes, limited to the equipment financed by those notes.
- (iii) Purchase-money Liens securing indebtedness in an aggregate amount not exceeding $1,000,000 at any time outstanding.
- (iv) Liens for taxes not yet due and payable.

The Equipment Notes are promissory notes issued to Prairie Equipment Finance and secured only by the equipment they finance [D2, §1.1]. FY2025 total funded debt includes equipment notes of 11,000 [D1, §4].

### 4.5 Change of Control (Event of Default)

The draft states: "It shall be an Event of Default if the Founders cease to own, directly or indirectly, a meaningful portion of the voting equity interests of the Borrower, or cease to be actively involved in the management of the Borrower." [D2, §7.6] "Founders" means Erik Halvorsen and Maria Halvorsen [D2, §1.1].

- **Schedule 1.1 not provided.** The definition of "Expansion Project" is needed to apply the §7.3 exclusion [D2, §1.1, §7.3]. Other defined terms are in the full draft agreement.
- **Event of Default provisions.** No other Events of Default (payment, cross-default, cure periods) appear in the excerpt. Not in provided documents: the full Events of Default article of the draft agreement.
